data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

North Reef Capital Management LP's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in FRST, MYFW, and COSO.

FRST reported Q2 2026 net income of $9.4M versus $2.4M a year earlier, up 286.8% year over year. (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1325670/000110465926092672/0001104659-26-092672-index.htm)

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records—permits, agendas, call reports, and filings—with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
